panels.title: 시간대별 Prompt 길이 / Output Token / 비용

targets.rawSql: select prompt_char_bucket, count(*) as turns, round(avg(output_tokens)::numeric, 2) as avg_output_tokens, round(avg(total_tokens)::numeric, 2) as avg_total_tokens, round(avg(estimated_cost_usd)::numeric, 6) as avg_cost_usd, round(avg(estimated_retry_count)::numeric, 2) as avg_retry_proxy, round(100.0 * avg(case when has_failure then 1.0 else 0.0 end), 2) as failed_turn_ratio_pct from codex_prompt_turns_dashboard where $__timeFilter(helper_event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repo_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repo_name = $v$${repo_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${git_branch:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or git_branch = $v$${git_branch:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or primary_model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${thread_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or thread_id = $v$${thread_id:text}$v$) group by prompt_char_bucket, prompt_char_bucket_order order by prompt_char_bucket_order;

select session_started_at, session_last_event_time, thread_id, user_id, team, repo_name, git_branch, turn_count, total_prompt_chars, total_output_tokens, round(total_estimated_cost_usd::numeric, 8) as total_estimated_cost_usd, total_failed_tool_calls, total_estimated_retries, round(failed_turn_ratio_pct::numeric, 2) as failed_turn_ratio_pct, session_max_trace_duration_ms from codex_prompt_sessions_dashboard where $__timeFilter(session_started_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repo_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repo_name = $v$${repo_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${git_branch:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or git_branch = $v$${git_branch:text}$v$) and ($v$${thread_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or thread_id = $v$${thread_id:text}$v$) order by total_estimated_cost_usd desc, session_started_at desc limit 50;

select helper_event_time, thread_id, turn_id, user_id, team, repo_name, git_branch, primary_model, input_message_char_count, output_tokens, round(estimated_cost_usd::numeric, 8) as estimated_cost_usd, failed_tool_call_count, failed_api_request_count, estimated_retry_count, tool_names, failed_tool_names, request_type_counts from codex_prompt_turns_dashboard where $__timeFilter(helper_event_time) and (has_failure = true or estimated_retry_count > 0) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repo_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repo_name = $v$${repo_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${git_branch:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or git_branch = $v$${git_branch:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or primary_model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${thread_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or thread_id = $v$${thread_id:text}$v$) order by failed_tool_call_count desc, estimated_retry_count desc, estimated_cost_usd desc, helper_event_time desc limit 50;

select helper_event_time, thread_id, turn_id, user_id, team, repo_name, git_branch, models, input_message_char_count, output_tokens, round(estimated_cost_usd::numeric, 8) as estimated_cost_usd, failed_tool_call_count, estimated_retry_count, round(output_tokens_per_1k_prompt_chars::numeric, 2) as output_tokens_per_1k_prompt_chars, round(cost_per_1k_prompt_chars::numeric, 8) as cost_per_1k_prompt_chars, recommendation from codex_prompt_optimization_candidates_dashboard where $__timeFilter(helper_event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repo_name:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repo_name = $v$${repo_name:text}$v$) and ($v$${git_branch:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or git_branch = $v$${git_branch:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or models like '%' || $v$${model:text}$v$ || '%') and ($v$${thread_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or thread_id = $v$${thread_id:text}$v$) order by helper_event_time desc limit 50;
